name: Price Calculator
job: Internal price math for downstream copy. Never writes opportunity.monetaryValue. Tags v2_price_calc when done. This is WF-17, not a WF-06 variant.

trigger.notes: Internal-only calculator; never fires customer-facing outreach directly.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Price-calc input changed
named_steps.comment: Sole entry. Must not fire customer outreach here.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.price_calc_inputs (native math staging)
named_steps.comment: Stores calculator inputs. Must not write to opportunity.monetaryValue.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on pay_type (PIF | SF | CARE | MAG | Other)
named_steps.comment: Reads pay_type only. Must not write pay_type.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.price_calc_result (internal only)
named_steps.comment: Stores computed price copy. Must not write opportunity.monetaryValue or move stages.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_price_calc (audit)
named_steps.comment: New v2 tag marking calc-complete. Must not remove any live tag.
